name: ES Mean Reversion — RSI + Bollinger Bands (1H RTH)
description: Mean reversion strategy on ES E-Mini futures (1H bars). Dual confirmation entry: RSI(14) oversold/overbought + Bollinger Band (20, 2σ) touch. Exits on mean reversion to RSI 50 or BB midband crossback. ATR-based risk sizing at 1% equity per trade with 1.5×ATR(14) hard stop. Trades only during US RTH (09:30–16:00 ET). Continuous front-month contract with rollover 5 days before expiry.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES Mean Reversion — RSI(14) + Bollinger Bands (20, 2σ)
# Intraday 1H bars, RTH session filter, ATR-based risk sizing
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Continuous front-month ES contract ---
src = study_assets()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=5
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open = cont.o

# --- Session Filter: RTH 09:30–16:00 ET ---
rth = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'),
    agg=[]
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c)
is_rth = rth.active

# --- Indicators ---
# RSI(14) on continuation close
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 std dev)
bb_upper, bb_mid, bb_lower = bbands(close, period=20, stddev=2.0)

# ATR(14) for stop distance and position sizing
atr_val = atr(high, low, close, 14)

# --- Entry Signals (dual confirmation + RTH gate) ---
# Long: RSI < 30 AND close <= lower BB, during RTH
long_condition = rsi_val < 30 and close <= bb_lower and is_rth

# Short: RSI > 70 AND close >= upper BB, during RTH
short_condition = rsi_val > 70 and close >= bb_upper and is_rth

# --- Exit Signals (mean reversion targets) ---
# Long exit: RSI crosses above 50 OR close crosses above BB midband
long_exit = crossover(rsi_val, 50) or crossover(close, bb_mid)

# Short exit: RSI crosses below 50 OR close crosses below BB midband
short_exit = crossunder(rsi_val, 50) or crossunder(close, bb_mid)

# --- Signal Persistence ---
# hold_until persists entry state until exit fires
# Long condition is persistent (comparison), but we need discrete entry/exit management
# Use hold_until to create held zones, then gate with RTH
held_long = hold_until(long_condition, long_exit)
held_short = hold_until(short_condition, short_exit)

# --- Execution Chain (E16 wiring order) ---
# 1. Rollover policy (required for futures)
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# 2. Signal executor — long and short zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# 3. Risk-based position sizing
# risk_unit bundles the stop loss — do NOT add separate stop_loss
# 1% equity risk per trade, 1.5× ATR(14) stop distance, ES multiplier = $50/point
stop_distance = atr_val * 1.5
risk_unit(
    stop_unit=StopUnit.price,
    contract_multiplier=50
)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=stop_distance)
